entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: mixed operand is not admitted for %s at %s
entries.rationale: This is a fail-closed registration invariant. lowerLabelCallOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp passes the fixed root site after its label-only recognizer, and projectAttributesOverInner invokes this resolver only for a Mixed input with the actual label-rewrite family and the fixed existing-plan site. Both entries are registered as mixedPreserve; the resolver maps that mode to the forwarder's preserveMixedSamplePayload behavior. The table is not query-configurable. Missing sites and incompatible modes are synthetic authority-test cases, not states a parsed production dispatch can supply; ordinary float inputs retain their prior route.

guard: default of switch mixedOperandPolicies[key] over [case mixedPreserve; default]
